title: Whether a Danish region should send any of its general practices into its 2027 statin follow-up programme, set by each practice's twelve-month persistence among its new statin users of the second half of 2025, with the 2026 pharmacy pilot's settlement and each practice's continuing statin users of 2026
subdomain: medication-adherence-persistence (a regional medicines unit measuring persistence with statins from a dispensing register that records packs, strengths and dates but no dose)
prompt_shape: 10: a scorecard, every practice's persistence set against the programme line, with the pilot pharmacies' 2026 entitlement and each practice's continuing users
stated_inputs: the programme, its selection line and the definitions of a new statin user, persistence and continuing users (programme description sections 2 and 3)
the pilot's conversation and payment terms (pilot agreement sections 1 and 2)

sources.origin: generated by task255/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional Danish region, its general practices and pharmacies, statin products, patients with their own daily doses and refill habits, personal-number replacements and a 2026 pharmacy pilot; every organisation, place, product name and person is invented, and no real dataset is reproduced. The ATC/DDD values are the WHO index's published defined daily doses for C10AA.

files.description: Statin dispensings to the region's residents, 1 July 2024 to 31 December 2026, one row per dispensing
The CPR register's person table for every pseudonym in the extract (sex, birth date, previous number)
Statin products on the Danish market (product number, name, ATC code, strength, pack size)
ATC/DDD index for lipid modifying agents (C10AA) as applied by the region from 2026
The region's general practices with listed patients per quarter of 2026
The pharmacies of the 2026 statin follow-up pilot
Statin follow-up programme 2027, programme description adopted 26 January 2027
Pharmacy pilot agreement 2026 (follow-up conversations and payment)
Pilot conversation log 2026 kept by the pharmacies
Quarterly pilot statements 2026 sent to the pharmacies
Statin use by town in 2025 in DDD per 1,000 inhabitants per day, as published
Patient survey of general practice, autumn 2026
